name: p2-zipdma-refusal-two-channel-profile
notes: negative configuration: the profile itself (not a behavior file) declares channels 2 and beat_bytes 8 over the same pinned ZipDMA RTL
expected refusal: dma-profile-capability-beyond-device:zipdma:channels:2>1 (the capability loop names the first key in DMA_CAPABILITY_KEYS order and the numbers it compared)
this is the same device as every other zipdma profile; a second profile of one RTL is never a second device

no dma_capability sidecar is declared on purpose: the sidecar carries a profile fingerprint, and this scenario deliberately pins a profile whose own capability block must be refused before any artifact is bound
